title: MARQ: A Modular, LLM-Agnostic Requirement Quality Assessor Infused with Systems Engineering Knowledge
abstract: arXiv:2610.36234v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Requirements engineering (RE) is foundational to systems engineering (SE), as requirement defects can propagate downstream and adversely affect development outcomes. Although large language models (LLMs) are promising for requirement quality assessment, prior work shows that off-the-shelf models miss a large share of expert-identified defects, perform unevenly across quality criteria, and vary across executions. This study investigates whether infusing expert-derived SE knowledge can improve LLM-based requirement quality evaluation beyond off-the-shelf capability. We present MARQ, a modular, LLM-agnostic prototype that supplements LLMs with a criterion-specific knowledge stack operationalizing INCOSE requirement quality criteria and evaluated against off-the-shelf baselines on an expert-labeled NASA requirement set using Claude Opus 5, GPT-5.6 Sol, and the open-weight Gemma 3 12B, with 100 executions per model. MARQ achieves median F1 sc

translated_title: MARQ：一个注入系统工程知识的模块化、大模型无关的需求质量评估器
translated_abstract: 需求工程（RE）是系统工程（SE）的基础，因为需求缺陷会向下游传播并对开发结果产生不利影响。尽管大语言模型（LLM）在需求质量评估方面前景可观，但先前研究表明，现成模型会遗漏大量专家识别出的缺陷，在不同质量准则上的表现参差不齐，且多次执行之间结果存在差异。本研究探究注入专家提炼的系统工程知识能否使基于大语言模型的需求质量评估超越现成模型的能力。我们提出了MARQ，一个模块化、大模型无关的原型系统，它通过一个针对具体质量准则的知识栈来增强大语言模型，该知识栈对INCOSE需求质量准则进行了可操作化的实现。我们在一个由专家标注的NASA需求数据集上，使用Claude Opus 5、GPT-5.6 Sol以及开放权重的Gemma 3 12B进行评估（每个模型执行100次），并与现成基线进行对比。MARQ取得了中位数F1分……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: MARQ是一个模块化、与具体大模型无关的需求质量评估原型，通过注入基于INCOSE准则可操作化的系统工程专家知识，显著提升了大语言模型在不同质量准则下识别需求缺陷的能力，超越了现成模型的表现。
en_tdlr: MARQ is a modular, LLM-agnostic requirement quality assessor that infuses operationalized INCOSE-based systems engineering knowledge into LLMs, substantially improving expert-defect detection beyond off-the-shelf model capability across multiple quality criteria.
